definition.text: Toward Jehovah are my eyes, the name of several men mentioned in the Old Testament (1 Chr. 7:8; 4:36; Ezra 10:22, 27). Among these was the eldest son of Neariah, son of Shemaiah, of the descendants of Zerubbabel. His family are the latest mentioned in the Old Testament (1 Chr. 3:23, 24).

lemmas.gloss: Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites
Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites
Eljashib, the name of six Israelites
Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites
